description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetActionLogAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to retrieve logs of actions performed on a specific timesheet within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching timesheet action logs with support for sorting and pagination, validation rules, and utilizes traits for timesheet services and user role management.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving action logs related to a specific timesheet, supporting sorting, pagination, and role-based access control.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of timesheet action logs, validates permissions, applies sorting and pagination, and returns the logs and total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring that timesheet ID is positive and that sorting/pagination parameters are valid.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as creating logs via this endpoint is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception, as deleting logs via this endpoint is not supported.
